notes.title: Update notes for patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
[u]New Features[/u]
Added New Secret Unlocks:
Discover new secrets and hidden areas. Enjoy the thrill of finding and unlocking new content!

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
Fixed Menu Clipping Bug:
Resolved an issue that could cause a black screen when navigating the menu.

[u]Improvements[/u]
Tweaked Shadowmen:
Adjusted the positions of some of the more challenging Shadowmen for a better gameplay experience.

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.8
notes.content:
Adjustments to the Shadowman's behavior have been made to enhance the gameplay experience. The Shadowman, previously a fleeting presence, will now initiate consequences for direct eye contact. Players are advised to exercise caution, as prolonged exposure may result in deadly repercussions.

Other fixes:
1. Added a new deadly train stop after the second platform in Episode 2.
2. More items added to Franks apartment.
3. Minor Audio tweaks and bug fixes.

notes.title: Nominate Us For the "Best Soundtrack" Award!
notes.content:
We're very proud of the LIMINAL PHASE OST. The dark and eerie music sets the tone and atmosphere in our VR horror experience. It was designed to invoke fear in the player, but also to capture the protagonist Frank's inner turmoil. 

If you enjoyed the music in LIMINAL PHASE, then be sure to nominate us for the "Best Soundtrack" Award!

We appreciate the support!

notes.title: Update notes for 1.0.7
notes.content:
We've just released version 1.0.7!
With this update, we have made some major changes to core player mechanics.

[b]1. Support for room scale[/b]
We've added room-scale and the annoying "Out of bounds" message is now gone. The game is still played best stationery. 

[b]2. Player speed tweaks[/b]
The player speed is now adjusted (faster), and should also be consistent on all headsets.

[b]3. Updated physics[/b]
The physics detection calculations are improved, which means that you can now pick up a glass with the fork and spin it around 🙂

Besides this, we've also:
[list]
[*] done some minor graphical tweaks.
[*] fixed a bug where you could accidentally push through geometry.
[/list]
If you find any bugs, please let us know in the Steam forum: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1999630/discussions/1/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1999630/discussions/1/[/url]

Thank you for the feedback and support!

notes.title: Thank you for the feedback!
notes.content:
After getting player feedback we've been prioritizing two major issues:

[b]1. No support for room-scale.[/b]
We are adding room-scale so that you will be able to move away from the start position without an annoying "Out of bounds" text popping up. We still recommend playing the game sitting or standing.

[b]2. Player speed is too slow.[/b]
This is something that affects players using a headset with a refresh rate below 90Hz. We are aware of this issue and it will get fixed when we update the tracking mode. 

We are aiming to update the game as soon as possible, hopefully within a week from now.

Besides the above updates, in the coming weeks, we will work on and add: 
[list]
[*] Visual, audio and mechanical tweaks.
[*] More random scare events.
[*] More secrets.
[/list]
If you find any bugs, please let us know in the Steam forum: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1999630/discussions/1/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1999630/discussions/1/[/url]

Thank you for the feedback and support!

notes.title: Announcing LIMINAL PHASE (PCVR)
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce our second VR production called LIMINAL PHASE, which is a VR action horror game set in an alternate ‘90s. Fight disturbing monsters, solve peculiar puzzles, and explore your fractured mind, as it gets harder for you to separate the real world from the games you play. You’ll find more information on our website: https://www.liminalphasevr.se

Our game trailer was featured in the Upload VR Showcase earlier today which was also live on IGN as part of the “IGN’s Summer of Gaming line-up”, which was super exciting for us!
